before.requirement: Link the fuzzer against the root-level Autotools libcares archive.
before.reason: Before the change, the root Makefile defines libcares.la; the old harness links its root .libs archive.

after.requirement: Link the fuzzer against the libcares archive built under src/lib.
after.reason: After the change, the root build delegates to subdirectories and src/lib defines the library target, while the old harness still names the root archive.

source_evidence.quote:
DISTCLEANFILES = include/ares_build.h

DIST_SUBDIRS = include src test docs

SUBDIRS = @BUILD_SUBDIRS@

AC_CONFIG_FILES([Makefile           \
                 include/Makefile   \
                 src/Makefile       \
                 src/lib/Makefile   \
                 src/tools/Makefile \
                 docs/Makefile      \
                 libcares.pc ])

EXTRA_DIST = fuzzcheck.sh CMakeLists.txt Makefile.m32 Makefile.msvc README.md buildconf
arestest_LDADD = libgmock.la $(ARES_BLD_DIR)/src/lib/libcares.la $(PTHREAD_LIBS)
aresfuzz_LDADD = $(ARES_BLD_DIR)/src/lib/libcares.la
aresfuzzname_LDADD = $(ARES_BLD_DIR)/src/lib/libcares.la
dnsdump_LDADD = $(ARES_BLD_DIR)/src/lib/libcares.la

claims.reason: The fixed harness requests the same root archive on both sides. That path corresponds to the before library target but not the after target.
